failure.summary: The generated gates.txt never implements even a single gate: its own probes at step 98 show OR(b0,b1), XOR, AND, NOT and COPY all returning bit 0, and ./sim 1/4/9/16 all print 0; the grader's table prints 1 for every N. The agent kept regenerating the whole netlist generator instead of fixing the signal-indexing convention, and the 7200 s budget expired while it was still debugging the primitives.

candidates.why_relevant: Card for 'a reference evaluator prints named metrics and you must produce an output file': iterate candidate outputs against the official checker until it passes, and write the artifact only when the checker passes. /app/sim is exactly that evaluator here.
Requires verifying the output file with wc/diff before declaring success; the model never checked its gates.txt against the examples in the prompt (sim 208 == 377) before continuing.

pending_relevant.why_relevant: Pending closed-plan card would have fixed the acceptance command (/app/sim 208 -> 377) as the gate before any full-netlist work.

skill_use.detail: Only the remote-asset-recovery card was opened, which is irrelevant - sim.c and gcc were already present. The evaluator-iteration and verify-before-success cards were never opened; the model did run ./sim intermittently but never treated the prompt's example (208 -> 377) as a blocking gate.

verdict.rationale: The task provides a local oracle (sim.c + two worked examples) yet the delivered file fails on the simplest primitives, which the model saw and could not diagnose before the 2 h timeout; no delivered skill covers gate-netlist construction.
